subject.title: fix(sessions): large histories no longer load entire transcripts

question: May schema-v10 upgrades synchronously rebuild an arbitrarily large dirty transcript on the first history or search request, or must migrated projection reconciliation move to a background or maintenance owner before merge?
rationale: The implementation is otherwise coherent and well-proven, but repository policy treats stored migrations, request blocking, and process availability as upgrade decisions requiring explicit owner intent.

options.title: Move Rebuild Off Requests
options.body: Run projection reconciliation through a bounded background or maintenance owner so history requests remain indexed and bounded immediately after upgrade.

options.title: Accept One-Time Blocking
options.body: Land the synchronous first-read rebuild only with explicit acceptance, measured worst-case latency and memory bounds, and an operator-visible recovery path.

recommendation.title: Move Rebuild Off Requests
recommendation.body: Run projection reconciliation through a bounded background or maintenance owner so history requests remain indexed and bounded immediately after upgrade.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged transcript-core history and current schema-v10 branch make this person the strongest available owner for the reconciliation contract.
